## Shell Scripts
### POC_MAC_D_CO_SS_APP_FileVaultEscrowBuddy
Description: Designed to capture existing FileVault keys from devices encrypted before they have been enrolled to Intune, not for ADE devices\.

https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/tree/master/macOS/Config/Escrow%20Buddy
#### Assignments
|intent |      target       |filter type|filter name|
|-------|-------------------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|SG_MDM_D_MAC_CO    |none       |           |
|Exclude|SG_MDM_D_MAC_CO_ADE|none       |           |

|Display Name                 |POC_MAC_D_CO_SS_APP_FileVaultEscrowBuddy |Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br># Script Name: installEB.sh<br># Description: This script downloads and installs the latest release of Escrow Buddy, a security agent plugin for macOS. <br>#              The script checks if the log directory has been created and creates it if necessary. <br>#              It also defines several functions for downloading and updating Escrow Buddy, as well as checking if the Escrow Buddy authorizationdb entry is configured. <br>#              The logger function is used to log messages to stdout and a log file.<br># Version: 1.0.2<br># Author: Tobias Almén<br># Date: 2024-06-14<br><br># Manual version override<br>version="" # Only configure this if you want to control the version of Escrow Buddy that is installed, otherwise leave it blank. Example: version="1.0.0"<br><br># Set the path to the installed Escrow Buddy bundle<br>install_path="/Library/Security/SecurityAgentPlugins/Escrow Buddy.bundle"<br># Set the path to the log directory<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/EscrowBuddy"<br># File to store last updatedtime<br>lastupdated="$logandmetadir/lastupdated"<br># Set the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>eb_url="https://api.github.com/repos/macadmins/escrow-buddy/releases/latest"<br># Set the path to the installed Escrow Buddy bundle<br>install_path="/Library/Security/SecurityAgentPlugins/Escrow Buddy.bundle"<br># Curl the API URL for the latest release and download url of Escrow Buddy<br>response=$(curl --silent "$eb_url")<br># Get the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>latest_release=$(echo "$response" \| grep -o '"tag_name": "[^"]*' \| grep -o '[^"]*$')<br># Get the numerical version of the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>latest_version=$(echo "$latest_release" \| cut -c 2-)<br># Get FDE status<br>FDE_STATUS=$(fdesetup status)<br># Get FDE profile status<br>FDE_PROFILE="/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.security.FDERecoveryKeyEscrow.plist"<br># Path to FileVaultPRK<br>PRK="/var/db/FileVaultPRK.dat"<br><br>## Check if the log directory has been created<br>if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then<br>  ## Already created<br>  echo "[$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")] [INFO] Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>  ## Creating Metadirectory<br>  echo "[$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")] [INFO] creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>  mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br># Function to log messages to stdout<br>function logger() {<br>    # Function to log messages to stdout and a log file<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   $1: The log level (e.g. INFO, WARNING, ERROR)<br>    #   $2: The message to log<br><br>    level=$1<br>    message=$2<br><br>    # Log the message with the current date and time and the specified log level<br>    date=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")<br>    echo "[$date] [$level] $message"<br>    echo "[$date] [$level] $message" >> "$logandmetadir/installeb.log"<br>}<br><br>function remediate() {<br>    # Function to remediate missing FV key<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   None<br>    # Returns:<br>    #   None<br>    # Variables:<br>    #   $FDE_STATUS: The status of FileVault<br>    #   $FDE_PROFILE: FDE profile path<br>    #   $PRK: The path to the FileVaultPRK<br><br>    # If FileVault is not enabled, exit<br>    if [ "FileVault is On." != "$FDE_STATUS" ]; then<br>        exit 0<br>    fi<br><br>    # If the escrow plist exists, check for the recovery key file<br>    if [ -f "$FDE_PROFILE" ]; then<br>        # If the key has been escrowed, exit<br>        if [ -f "$PRK" ]; then<br>            logger "INFO" "Key has been escrowed"<br>        # If the key has not been escrowed, set GenerateNewKey to true<br>        else<br>            logger "INFO" "Key has not been escrowed"<br>            defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.netflix.Escrow-Buddy.plist GenerateNewKey -bool true<br>        fi<br>    # If the escrow plist does not exist, do nothing<br>    else<br>        logger "INFO" "No FileVault profile has been applied"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>function getVersion() {<br>    # Convert a version string in the format x.y.z.w to an integer<br>    # Nabbed from Matt's WS1 example and slightly modified<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   $1: The version string to convert<br>    # Returns:<br>    #   The integer representation of the version string<br>    # Variables:<br>    #   None<br><br>    echo "$1" \| awk -F. '{ printf("%d%d%d%d\n", $1,$2,$3,$4); }'<br>}<br><br># Function to download the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>function downloadEscrowBuddy() {<br>    # Download the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   None<br>    # Returns:<br>    #   None<br>    # Variables:<br>    #   $response: The response from the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #   $download_url: The download URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br><br>    # Get the download URL for the latest release<br>    download_url=$(echo "$response" \| grep -o '"browser_download_url": "[^"]*' \| grep -o '[^"]*$' \| grep -i '\.pkg$')<br><br>    # Download the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    logger "INFO" "Downloading Escrow Buddy $latest_release"<br>    curl -L -s "$download_url" -o "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg"<br><br>    # Check if the download was successful<br>    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then<br>        logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy $latest_release downloaded successfully"<br>    else<br>        logger "ERROR" "Escrow Buddy $latest_release download failed"<br>        exit 1<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Function to update Escrow Buddy if a new version is available<br>function updateEscrowBuddy() {<br>    # Update Escrow Buddy if a new version is available<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   input_version: The highest version of Escrow Buddy to install<br>    # Returns:<br>    #   None<br>    # Variables:<br>    #   $response: The response from the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #   $download_url: The download URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #   $lastmodified: The last modified date of the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #   $previouslastmodifieddate: The last modified date of the previously installed release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #   $lastupdated: The path to the file containing the last modified date of the previously installed release of Escrow Buddy<br><br>    # Manual version override<br>    input_version=$1<br><br>    # If the input version is set, check if an update is available<br>    if [ "$input_version" ]; then <br>        # Check if Escrow Buddy is installed<br>        if [ -d "$install_path" ]; then<br>            # If the input version is not the same as the latest version, log a warning<br>            if [ $(getVersion $input_version) != $(getVersion $latest_version) ]; then<br>                logger "WARNING" "Input version [$input_version] does not match latest version [$latest_version]"<br>            # If the input version and the latest version are the same, check if an update is available<br>            else<br>                # Get the version of the currently installed release of Escrow Buddy<br>                installed_version=$(defaults read "$install_path"/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString)<br>                if [ $(getVersion $input_version) -gt $(getVersion $installed_version) ]; then<br>                    logger "INFO" "Update found, input version [$input_version] and current [$installed_version]"<br>                    # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>                    installEscrowBuddy<br>                else<br>                    logger "INFO" "No update found, input version [$input_version] and current [$installed_version]"<br>                fi<br>            fi<br>        else<br>            logger "INFO" "Unable to check for updates, Escrow Buddy is not installed, installing"<br>            # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>            installEscrowBuddy<br>        fi<br><br>    else<br>        # Get the download URL for the latest release<br>        download_url=$(echo "$response" \| grep -o '"browser_download_url": "[^"]*' \| grep -o '[^"]*$' \| grep -i '\.pkg$')<br>        # Get the last modified date for the latest release<br>        lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$download_url" \| grep -i "last-modified" \| awk '{$1=""; print $0}' \| awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' \| tr -d '\r')<br><br>        # Check if the last modified date of the latest release is different to the last modified date of the previously installed release<br>        if [ -f "$lastupdated" ]; then<br>            previouslastmodifieddate=$(cat "$lastupdated")<br>            if [[ "$previouslastmodifieddate" != "$lastmodified" ]]; then<br>                logger "INFO" "Update found, previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"<br><br>                # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>                installEscrowBuddy<br>            # If the last modified date of the latest release is the same as the last modified date of the previously installed release, do nothing<br>            else<br>                logger "INFO" "No update between previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"<br>            fi<br><br>        # If the last modified date of the previously installed release is not found, install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>        else<br>            logger "INFO" "Meta file [$lastupdated] not found"<br>            logger "INFO" "Unable to determine if update required so updating anyway"<br><br>            # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>            installEscrowBuddy<br><br>        fi<br><br>    fi<br><br>}<br><br># Function to install Escrow Buddy<br>function installEscrowBuddy() {<br>    # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy<br>    #<br>    # Arguments:<br>    #   None<br>    # Returns:<br>    #   None<br>    # Variables:<br>    #   None<br><br>    # Install Escrow Buddy<br>    downloadEscrowBuddy<br>    logger "INFO" "Installing Escrow Buddy"<br>    sudo installer -pkg "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg" -target "/" > /dev/null 2>&1<br>    exitcode=$?<br><br>    # Clean up<br>    rm -f "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg"<br><br>    # Check if the installation was successful<br>    if [ $exitcode -eq 0 ]; then<br>        logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy installed successfully"<br>        lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$download_url" \| grep -i "last-modified" \| awk '{$1=""; print $0}' \| awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' \| tr -d '\r')<br>        logger "INFO" "Writing last update information to [$lastupdated]"<br>        echo $lastmodified >"$lastupdated"<br>    else<br>        logger "ERROR" "Escrow Buddy installation failed"<br>        exit 1<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Check if Escrow Buddy is already installed<br>if [ -d "$install_path" ]; then<br>    # If Escrow Buddy is already installed, check if an update is required<br>    logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy already installed, checking for update" <br>    updateEscrowBuddy $version<br>else<br>    # If Escrow Buddy is not installed, install it<br>    logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy not installed, installing" <br>    installEscrowBuddy<br>fi<br><br># Check if Escrow Buddy authorizationdb entry is configured<br>"$install_path"/Contents/Resources/AuthDBSetup.sh \| while read line; do<br>    logger "INFO" "$line"<br>done<br><br># Run remediation<br>remediate</details>|

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>## IMM - Install Microsoft Remote Help (PKG)<br>##<br>## Version: 1.1.0<br>## Maintainer: manahum@microsoft.com<br>##<br>## Summary<br>## - Downloads and installs Microsoft Remote Help on macOS using a signed PKG.<br>## - If Microsoft Remote Help is already installed and autoUpdate=true, exits without changes.<br>## - Otherwise performs an update check via HTTP Last-Modified and a local meta file, then installs/updates Microsoft Remote Help.<br>## - Optionally terminates a running Microsoft Remote Help process before install when configured.<br>## - Implements automatic retry logic for download failures with detailed error diagnostics.<br>## - Detailed logging written to /Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installRemoteHelp/Microsoft Remote Help.log<br>##<br>## Inputs (variables)<br>## - weburl: Download URL for the Microsoft Remote Help PKG<br>## - appname, app, processpath, terminateprocess, autoUpdate<br>##<br>## Artifacts (outputs)<br>## - Log: /Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installRemoteHelp/Microsoft Remote Help.log<br>## - Meta: /Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installRemoteHelp/Microsoft Remote Help.meta (Last-Modified)<br>##<br>## Requirements<br>## - macOS 11 or later<br>## - Root privileges<br>## - Built-ins: curl, installer, softwareupdate, rsync<br>##<br>## Exit codes<br>## - 0: Success (installed or no action required)<br>## - 1: Failure (unsupported package type)<br>## - 6-56+: curl-specific error codes (DNS, network, SSL, timeout, etc.)<br>##<br>## Usage<br>## - Run as root via Intune device script or your management workflow.<br>############################################################################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: manahum@microsoft.com<br><br># User Defined variables<br><br>weburl="https://aka.ms/downloadremotehelpmacos"                        # The URL to download the PKG from (should be a direct link to a PKG for best results)<br>appname="Microsoft Remote Help"                                                        # The name of our App deployment script<br>app="Microsoft Remote Help.app"                                                        # The actual name of our App once installed<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installRemoteHelp"      # The location of our logs and last updated data<br>processpath="/Applications//Microsoft Remote Help.app/Contents/MacOS/Microsoft Remote Help"    # The process name of the App we are installing<br>terminateprocess="true"                                                         # Do we want to terminate the running process? If false we'll wait until its not running<br>autoUpdate="true"                                                               # Application updates itself, if already installed we should exit<br><br># Generated variables<br>tempdir=$(mktemp -d)<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"                                               # The location of the script log file<br>metafile="$logandmetadir/$appname.meta"                                         # The location of our meta file (for updates)<br><br># Helpers<br><br>cleanup() {<br>    if [[ -d "$tempdir" ]]; then<br>        rm -rf "$tempdir"<br>    fi<br>}<br>trap cleanup EXIT<br><br># function to delay download if another download is running<br>waitForCurl () {<br><br>     while ps aux \| grep curl \| grep -v grep; do<br>          echo "$(date) \| Another instance of Curl is running, waiting 60s for it to complete"<br>          sleep 10<br>     done<br>     echo "$(date) \| No instances of Curl found, safe to proceed"<br><br>}<br><br><br># function to delay script if the specified process is running<br>waitForProcess () {<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    ##  Function to pause while a specified process is running<br>    ##  $1 = name of process to check for; $2 = delay; $3 = terminate true/false<br>    processName=$1<br>    fixedDelay=$2<br>    terminate=$3<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Waiting for other [$processName] processes to end"<br>    while ps aux \| grep "$processName" \| grep -v grep &>/dev/null; do<br>        if [[ $terminate == "true" ]]; then<br>            pid=$(pgrep -f "$processName" \| head -n1)<br>            if [[ -n "$pid" ]]; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| + [$appname] running, terminating [$processName] at pid [$pid]..."<br>                kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null \|\| true<br>            fi<br>            return<br>        fi<br>        if [[ ! $fixedDelay ]]; then<br>            delay=$(( $RANDOM % 50 + 10 ))<br>        else<br>            delay=$fixedDelay<br>        fi<br>        echo "$(date) \|  + Another instance of $processName is running, waiting [$delay] seconds"<br>        sleep $delay<br>    done<br>    echo "$(date) \| No instances of [$processName] found, safe to proceed"<br>}<br><br><br># Update the last modified date for this app<br>fetchLastModifiedDate() {<br>    if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Creating [$logandmetadir] to store metadata"<br>        mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"<br>    fi<br>    lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$weburl" \| grep -i "last-modified" \| awk '{$1=""; print $0}' \| awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' \| tr -d '\r')<br>    if [[ $1 == "update" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Writing last modified date [$lastmodified] to [$metafile]"<br>        echo "$lastmodified" > "$metafile"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Download PKG<br>downloadApp () {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Starting downlading of [$appname]"<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloading $appname [$weburl]"<br><br>    cd "$tempdir"<br>    curl -o "Microsoft_Remote_Help_installer.pkg" --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -L -J "$weburl"<br>    curlExitCode=$?<br>    <br>    # Retry once if curl failed<br>    if [[ $curlExitCode != 0 ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| First download attempt failed with exit code [$curlExitCode], retrying once more..."<br>        sleep 5<br>        curl -o "Microsoft_Remote_Help_installer.pkg" --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -L -J "$weburl"<br>        curlExitCode=$?<br>    fi<br>    <br>    if [[ $curlExitCode == 0 ]]; then<br>        tempfile="Microsoft_Remote_Help_installer.pkg"<br>        echo "$(date) \| Found downloaded tempfile [$tempfile]"<br>        case $tempfile in<br>            *.pkg\|*.PKG\|*.mpkg\|*.MPKG)<br>                packageType="PKG"<br>                ;;<br>            *)<br>                echo "$(date) \| Expected a PKG, but downloaded an unsupported type [$tempfile]"<br>                exit 1<br>                ;;<br>        esac<br>        echo "$(date) \| Downloaded [$app] to [$tempfile]"<br>        echo "$(date) \| Detected install type as [$packageType]"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Failed to download [$appname] from [$weburl]"<br>        echo "$(date) \| curl exit code: [$curlExitCode]"<br>        case $curlExitCode in<br>            6)  echo "$(date) \| Error: Could not resolve host. Check DNS settings." ;;<br>            7)  echo "$(date) \| Error: Failed to connect to host. Check network connectivity." ;;<br>            22) echo "$(date) \| Error: HTTP error (404/403). Check if download URL is valid." ;;<br>            28) echo "$(date) \| Error: Operation timeout. Check network speed/stability." ;;<br>            35) echo "$(date) \| Error: SSL connect error. Check system date/time and certificates." ;;<br>            56) echo "$(date) \| Error: Failure receiving network data. Network connection was interrupted." ;;<br>            *)  echo "$(date) \| Error: curl failed with exit code $curlExitCode. Check network/proxy settings." ;;<br>        esac<br>        echo "$(date) \| Troubleshooting: Verify network connectivity, proxy settings, and firewall rules."<br>        echo "$(date) \| You can test manually with: curl -v \"$weburl\""<br>        updateOctory failed<br>        exit $curlExitCode<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Check if we need to update or not<br>updateCheck() {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Checking if we need to install or update [$appname]"<br>    if [ -d "/Applications/$app" ]; then<br>        if [[ $autoUpdate == "true" ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| [$appname] is already installed and handles updates itself, exiting"<br>            exit 0<br>        fi<br>        echo "$(date) \| [$appname] already installed, let's see if we need to update"<br>        fetchLastModifiedDate<br>        if [[ -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then<br>            if [ -f "$metafile" ]; then<br>                previouslastmodifieddate=$(cat "$metafile")<br>                if [[ "$previouslastmodifieddate" != "$lastmodified" ]]; then<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Update found, previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"<br>                    update="update"<br>                else<br>                    echo "$(date) \| No update between previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Exiting, nothing to do"<br>                    exit 0<br>                fi<br>            else<br>                echo "$(date) \| Meta file [$metafile] not found"<br>                echo "$(date) \| Unable to determine if update required, updating [$appname] anyway"<br>            fi<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| [$appname] not installed, need to download and install"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>## Install PKG Function (PKG-only path)<br>installPKG () {<br>    waitForProcess "$processpath" "300" "$terminateprocess"<br>    echo "$(date) \| Installing $appname"<br><br>    if [[ -d "/Applications/$app" ]]; then<br>        rm -rf "/Applications/$app"<br>    fi<br><br>    installer -pkg "$tempfile" -target /Applications<br>    if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| $appname Installed"<br>        echo "$(date) \| Cleaning Up"<br>        rm -rf "$tempdir"<br>        echo "$(date) \| Application [$appname] succesfully installed"<br>        fetchLastModifiedDate update<br>        exit 0<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Failed to install $appname"<br>        rm -rf "$tempdir"<br>        exit 1<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>startLog() {<br>    if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Creating [$logandmetadir] to store logs"<br>        mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"<br>    fi<br>    exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1<br>}<br><br># delay until the user has finished setup assistant.<br>waitForDesktop () {<br>  until ps aux \| grep /System/Library/CoreServices/Dock.app/Contents/MacOS/Dock \| grep -v grep &>/dev/null; do<br>    delay=$(( $RANDOM % 50 + 10 ))<br>    echo "$(date) \|  + Dock not running, waiting [$delay] seconds"<br>    sleep $delay<br>  done<br>  echo "$(date) \| Dock is here, lets carry on"<br>}<br><br>###################################################################################<br>###################################################################################<br>## Begin Script Body<br>###################################################################################<br>###################################################################################<br><br>startLog<br><br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Logging install of [$appname] to [$log]"<br>echo "############################################################"<br>echo ""<br><br><br>waitForDesktop<br>waitForCurl<br>downloadApp<br><br><br># PKG only<br>if [[ $packageType == "PKG" ]]; then<br>    installPKG<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Unsupported package type [$packageType]"<br>    exit 1<br>fi<br></details>|

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## Script to download and set Desktop Wallpaper<br>##<br>## On macOS 14+ (Sonoma/Sequoia/Tahoe), simply replacing the image file on disk no longer<br>## triggers a wallpaper refresh. This script downloads the image and actively sets it as<br>## the desktop picture for the currently logged-in user via AppleScript.<br>##<br>## Requirements:<br>##   - Deploy the accompanying PPPC profile (wallpaper-pppc.mobileconfig) via Intune to<br>##     pre-authorize osascript -> Finder Apple Events. Without this, a TCC consent dialog<br>##     will appear on the user's screen.<br>##   - Optionally deploy wallpaper.mobileconfig as a fallback for the override-picture-path.<br>##<br>###########################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br><br># Define variables<br>usebingwallpaper=false # Set to true to have script fetch wallpaper from Bing<br>wallpaperurl="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ennnbeee/oddsandendpoints-scripts/refs/heads/main/Intune/PlatformScripts/Shell/TeamsBackgrounds/tile-bg-blueprint.png"<br>wallpaperdir="/Users/Shared"<br>wallpaperfile="Wallpaper.png"<br>log="/var/log/fetchdesktopwallpaper.log"<br>dockMaxWait=3600  # Maximum seconds to wait for Dock (60 minutes)<br><br># start logging<br><br>exec 1>> "$log" 2>&1<br><br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Starting download of Desktop Wallpaper"<br>echo "############################################################"<br>echo ""<br><br>##<br>## Wait for the Dock process to confirm we're at the user desktop.<br>## During Setup Assistant the Dock isn't running, and Finder Apple Events will fail.<br>##<br>dockWaited=0<br>while ! pgrep -x "Dock" > /dev/null 2>&1; do<br>    if [ "$dockWaited" -ge "$dockMaxWait" ]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Dock not running after ${dockMaxWait}s. Likely still in Setup Assistant. Exiting."<br>        exit 1<br>    fi<br>    if [ "$dockWaited" -eq 0 ]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Dock not running, waiting for user desktop..."<br>    fi<br>    sleep 5<br>    dockWaited=$((dockWaited + 5))<br>done<br>if [ "$dockWaited" -gt 0 ]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Dock is now running (waited ${dockWaited}s)"<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Dock is running"<br>fi<br><br>##<br>## Checking if Wallpaper directory exists and create it if it's missing<br>##<br>if [ -d "$wallpaperdir" ]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Wallpaper dir [$wallpaperdir] already exists"<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Creating [$wallpaperdir]"<br>    mkdir -p "$wallpaperdir"<br>fi<br><br>##<br>## Attempt to download the image file. No point checking if it already exists since we want to overwrite it anyway<br>##<br><br>if [ "$usebingwallpaper" = true ]; then<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Fetching today's Bing Wallpaper URL via JSON API"<br>    bingapiresponse=$(curl -sL "https://www.bing.com/HPImageArchive.aspx?format=js&idx=0&n=1&mkt=en-US")<br>    urlbase=$(echo "$bingapiresponse" \| grep -o '"urlbase":"[^"]*"' \| head -1 \| sed 's/"urlbase":"//;s/"//')<br><br>    if [ -n "$urlbase" ]; then<br>        wallpaperurl="https://www.bing.com${urlbase}_UHD.jpg"<br>        echo "$(date) \| Setting wallpaperurl to todays Bing Desktop [$wallpaperurl]"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Failed to parse Bing API response, falling back to default wallpaperurl"<br>    fi<br><br>fi<br><br>echo "$(date) \| Downloading Wallpaper from [$wallpaperurl] to [$wallpaperdir/$wallpaperfile]"<br>curl -L -o "$wallpaperdir/$wallpaperfile" "$wallpaperurl"<br>if [ "$?" != "0" ]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Failed to download wallpaper image from [$wallpaperurl]"<br>    exit 1<br>fi<br><br>echo "$(date) \| Wallpaper [$wallpaperurl] downloaded to [$wallpaperdir/$wallpaperfile]"<br><br>##<br>## Verify the downloaded file is actually an image<br>##<br>filetype=$(file -b --mime-type "$wallpaperdir/$wallpaperfile")<br>if [[ "$filetype" != image/* ]]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloaded file is not an image (detected: $filetype). Aborting wallpaper set."<br>    exit 1<br>fi<br><br>##<br>## Set the wallpaper for the currently logged-in user<br>## On macOS 14+ the Dock/WallpaperKit no longer picks up file changes automatically,<br>## so we must actively tell Finder to update the desktop picture.<br>##<br>currentUser=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console)<br>if [ "$currentUser" = "root" ] \|\| [ "$currentUser" = "loginwindow" ] \|\| [ -z "$currentUser" ]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| No user currently logged in (console user: ${currentUser:-none}). Wallpaper downloaded but not applied — it will be picked up by the override-picture-path profile at next login."<br>    exit 0<br>fi<br><br>currentUserUID=$(id -u "$currentUser")<br>echo "$(date) \| Setting wallpaper for user [$currentUser] (UID: $currentUserUID)"<br><br>wallpaperResult=$(/bin/launchctl asuser "$currentUserUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" /usr/bin/osascript -e "<br>    tell application \"Finder\"<br>        set desktop picture to POSIX file \"$wallpaperdir/$wallpaperfile\"<br>    end tell<br>" 2>&1)<br>osascriptExitCode=$?<br><br>if [ "$osascriptExitCode" = "0" ]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Wallpaper successfully set for user [$currentUser]"<br>    exit 0<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Failed to set wallpaper via osascript for user [$currentUser] (exit code: $osascriptExitCode)"<br>    echo "$(date) \| osascript output: $wallpaperResult"<br>    echo "$(date) \| Check that the PPPC profile (wallpaper-pppc.mobileconfig) is deployed."<br>    exit 1<br>fi<br></details>|

then<br>   ## Already created<br>   echo "# $(date) \| Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>   ## Creating Metadirectory<br>   echo "# $(date) \| creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>   mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br># start logging<br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br><br># Begin Script Body<br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Starting $appname"<br>echo "############################################################"<br>echo "Writing log output to [$log]"<br>echo ""<br><br>echo " $(date) \| Checking if renaming is necessary"<br><br>serialNum=$(system_profiler SPHardwareDataType \| awk '/Serial/ {print $4}' \| cut -d ':' -f2- \| xargs)<br>if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| Serial detected as $serialNum"<br>else<br>   echo "$(date) \| Unable to determine serial number"<br>   exit 1<br>fi<br><br>currentNameCheck=$(scutil --get ComputerName)<br>if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| Current computername detected as $currentNameCheck"<br>else<br>   echo "$(date) \| Unable to determine current name"<br>   exit 1<br>fi<br><br>echo " $(date) \| prefix variable set to $prefix"<br>echo " $(date) \| Retrieved serial number: $serialNum"<br>echo " $(date) \| Building the new name..."<br>newName=$prefix$separator$serialNum<br><br>echo " $(date) \| Generated Name: $newName"<br><br>if [[ "$currentNameCheck" == "$newName" ]]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| Rename not required already set to [$currentNameCheck]"<br>   exit 0<br>fi<br><br>#Setting ComputerName<br>scutil --set ComputerName $newName<br>if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| Computername changed from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>else<br>   echo " $(date) \| Failed to rename the device from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>   exit 1<br>fi<br><br>#Setting HostName<br>scutil --set HostName $newName<br>if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| HostName changed from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>else<br>   echo " $(date) \| Failed to rename the device from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>   exit 1<br>fi<br><br>#Setting LocalHostName<br>scutil --set LocalHostName $newName<br>if [ "$?" = "0" ]; then<br>   echo " $(date) \| LocalHostName changed from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>else<br>   echo " $(date) \| Failed to rename the device from $currentNameCheck to $newName"<br>   exit 1<br>fi<br></details>|

### POC_MAC_D_CO_SS_MicrosoftOneDrive_FinderSync
Description: This script enables the Finder Sync extension for Microsoft OneDrive so that when a user signs in to OneDrive they can configure Files on\-demand without needing to approve the extension in settings\. The script will work for OneDrive installed by downloading the PKG or the VPP version\.

https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/tree/master/macOS/Config/Enable%20OneDrive%20Finder%20Sync
#### Assignments
|intent |    target     |filter type|filter name|
|-------|---------------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|SG_MDM_D_MAC_CO|none       |           |

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## Script to enable the Finder Extension for OneDrive<br>##<br>############################################################################################<br>#<br># NOTE<br># Script must run in user credentials<br>#<br>############################################################################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: scbree@microsoft.com<br><br>Application="/Applications/OneDrive.app"<br>logandmetadir="/tmp/EnableOneDriveFinderSync"<br>log="$logandmetadir/Script-EnableOneDriveFinderSync.log"<br><br>## Check if the log directory has been created<br>if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then<br>    ## Already created<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>    ## Creating Metadirectory<br>    echo "# $(date) \| creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>    mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br>exec 1>>$log 2>&1<br><br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Starting config of $Application"<br>echo "############################################################"<br>echo ""<br><br>echo "$(date) \| OneDrive config: Looking for required applications... "<br><br>#wait for OneDrive to be installed<br>while [[ $ready -ne 1 ]]; do<br><br>    if [[ -e "$Application" ]]; then<br>        ready=1<br>        echo "$(date) \| $Application found!"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| OneDrive config: $i not installed yet"<br>        echo "$(date) \| OneDrive config: Waiting for 60 seconds"<br>        sleep 60<br>    fi<br><br>done<br><br>## Get Extension Name (differs between standalone and VPP version)<br>echo "$(date) \| Finding installed OneDrive type (VPP or standalone)"<br>if pluginkit -m \| grep "com.microsoft.OneDrive-mac.FinderSync"; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| OneDrive installed via VPP. Extension name is com.microsoft.OneDrive-mac.FinderSync"<br>    ExtensionName="com.microsoft.OneDrive-mac.FinderSync"<br>fi<br><br>if pluginkit -m \| grep "com.microsoft.OneDrive.FinderSync"; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| OneDrive installed standalone. Extension name is com.microsoft.OneDrive.FinderSync"<br>    ExtensionName="com.microsoft.OneDrive.FinderSync"<br>fi<br><br>## check if the extension is already enabled and enable it<br>echo "$(date) \| Checking extension status"<br>if pluginkit -m \| grep "+    $ExtensionName"; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| OneDrive FinderSync already enabled"<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| OneDrive config: Enabling FinderSync"<br>    echo "$(date) \| running pluginkit -e use -i $ExtensionName"<br><br>    pluginkit -e use -i $ExtensionName<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Script finished"<br>fi<br></details>|

### POC_MAC_D_CO_SS_MicrosoftOneDrive_OpenAtLogin
Description: Enables the OneDrive login item via OneDrive's /createloginitem command \(26\.027\+\) so OneDrive launches automatically at login for the signed\-in user\. Needed because the legacy OpenAtLogin preference is deprecated \(a no\-op since sync app 24\.113\) and a Managed Login Items profile can only allow a login item, not enable it\.
#### Assignments
|intent |  target   |filter type|filter name|
|-------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|All Devices|none       |           |

#### Configuration
|           setting           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Execution Frequency          |PT15M |Block Execution Notifications|False |Display Name                 |POC_MAC_D_CO_SS_MicrosoftOneDrive_OpenAtLogin                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/zsh<br># Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.<br># Licensed under the MIT License.<br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## SCR-APP-108 - OneDrive Open at Login<br>##<br>## Enables the OneDrive login item via OneDrive's /createloginitem command (26.027+)<br>## so OneDrive launches automatically at login for the signed-in user. Needed because<br>## the legacy OpenAtLogin preference is deprecated (a no-op since sync app 24.113) and<br>## a Managed Login Items profile (POL-SYS-101) can only allow a login item, not enable it.<br>##<br>## Requirements:<br>##   - Run script as signed-in user = YES (open -a fails outside the user's Aqua session)<br>##   - Execution frequency = every 15 min; idempotent - no-ops until OneDrive >= 26.027<br>##     is installed, runs the enable once, then a per-user marker keeps runs a no-op.<br>##<br>############################################################################################<br><br>set -u<br>ONEDRIVE="/Applications/OneDrive.app"<br>MINVER="26.027"   # first OneDrive build supporting /createloginitem<br>MARKER="$HOME/Library/Application Support/IntuneMyMacs/onedrive-loginitem.done"<br><br>log() { echo "[onedrive-openatlogin] $*"; }<br><br># Guard 0 - already registered on this account; keeps the 15-min cadence a cheap<br># no-op that never re-launches OneDrive. Delete the marker file to force a re-run.<br>if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]]; then<br>  log "Login item already registered (marker present) - no-op."<br>  exit 0<br>fi<br><br># Guard 1 - no-op until OneDrive is installed (the app install may lag this script).<br>if [[ ! -d "$ONEDRIVE" ]]; then<br>  log "OneDrive not installed yet - no-op; will retry next run."<br>  exit 0<br>fi<br><br># Guard 2 - /createloginitem needs OneDrive >= 26.027. Older builds still honour<br># the OpenAtLogin managed pref, so just no-op rather than launching the full app.<br>ver=$(defaults read "$ONEDRIVE/Contents/Info" CFBundleShortVersionString 2>/dev/null \|\| echo "0")<br>ok=$(awk -v v="$ver" -v m="$MINVER" 'BEGIN{split(v,a,".");split(m,b,".");print (a[1]*100000+a[2] >= b[1]*100000+b[2])?1:0}')<br>if [[ "$ok" != "1" ]]; then<br>  log "OneDrive $ver < $MINVER - /createloginitem unavailable; relying on OpenAtLogin pref. No-op."<br>  exit 0<br>fi<br><br># Enable the OneDrive login item. Fire-and-exit; does not launch the full sync<br># client. Then drop the marker so Guard 0 no-ops every subsequent run.<br>open -a "$ONEDRIVE" --args /createloginitem<br>mkdir -p "${MARKER:h}"<br>print -r -- "registered OneDrive $ver at login" > "$MARKER"<br>log "Requested OneDrive login-item registration (OneDrive $ver); marker written."<br>exit 0<br></details>|
|Run As Account               |user |File Name                    |scr-app-108-onedrive-openatlogin.zsh |Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/zsh --no-rcs<br><br>##  This script will attempt to audit all of the settings based on the installed profile.<br><br>##  This script is provided as-is and should be fully tested on a system that is not in a production environment.<br><br>###################  Variables  ###################<br><br>pwpolicy_file=""<br><br>###################  DEBUG MODE - hold shift when running the script  ###################<br><br>shiftKeyDown=$(osascript -l JavaScript -e "ObjC.import('Cocoa'); ($.NSEvent.modifierFlags & $.NSEventModifierFlagShift) > 1")<br><br>if [[ $shiftKeyDown == "true" ]]; then<br>    echo "-----DEBUG-----"<br>    set -o xtrace -o verbose<br>fi<br><br>###################  COMMANDS START BELOW THIS LINE  ###################<br><br># Check if the current shell is Zsh<br>if [[ -z "$ZSH_NAME" ]]; then<br>  echo "ERROR: This script must be run in Zsh."<br>  exit 1<br>fi<br><br>## Must be run as root<br>if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then<br>    echo "ERROR: This script must be run as root"<br>    exit 1<br>fi<br><br># path to PlistBuddy<br>plb="/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy"<br><br># get the currently logged in user<br>CURRENT_USER=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow lastUserName)<br>CURR_USER_UID=$(/usr/bin/id -u $CURRENT_USER)<br><br># get system architecture<br>arch=$(/usr/bin/arch)<br><br># configure colors for text<br>RED='\e[31m'<br>STD='\e[39m'<br>GREEN='\e[32m'<br>YELLOW='\e[33m'<br><br>audit_plist="/Library/Preferences/org.cis_lvl1.audit.plist"<br>audit_log="/Library/Logs/cis_lvl1_baseline.log"<br><br># pause function<br>pause(){<br>vared -p "Press [Enter] key to continue..." -c fackEnterKey<br>}<br><br># logging function<br>logmessage(){<br>    if [[ ! $quiet ]];then<br>        echo "$(date -u) $1" \| /usr/bin/tee -a "$audit_log"<br>    elif [[ ${quiet[2][2]} == 1 ]];then<br>        if [[ $1 == *" failed"* ]] \|\| [[ $1 == *"exemption"* ]] ;then<br>            echo "$(date -u) $1" \| /usr/bin/tee -a "$audit_log"<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date -u) $1" \| /usr/bin/tee -a "$audit_log" > /dev/null<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date -u) $1" \| /usr/bin/tee -a "$audit_log" > /dev/null<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>ask() {<br>    # if fix flag is passed, assume YES for everything<br>    if [[ $fix ]] \|\| [[ $cfc ]]; then<br>        return 0<br>    fi<br><br>    while true; do<br><br>        if [ "${2:-}" = "Y" ]; then<br>            prompt="Y/n"<br>            default=Y<br>        elif [ "${2:-}" = "N" ]; then<br>            prompt="y/N"<br>            default=N<br>        else<br>            prompt="y/n"<br>            default=<br>        fi<br><br>        # Ask the question - use /dev/tty in case stdin is redirected from somewhere else<br>        printf "${YELLOW} $1 [$prompt] ${STD}"<br>        read REPLY<br><br>        # Default?<br>        if [ -z "$REPLY" ]; then<br>            REPLY=$default<br>        fi<br><br>        # Check if the reply is valid<br>        case "$REPLY" in<br>            Y*\|y*) return 0 ;;<br>            N*\|n*) return 1 ;;<br>        esac<br><br>    done<br>}<br><br># function to display menus<br>show_menus() {<br>    lastComplianceScan=$(defaults read /Library/Preferences/org.cis_lvl1.audit.plist lastComplianceCheck)<br><br>    if [[ $lastComplianceScan == "" ]];then<br>        lastComplianceScan="No scans have been run"<br>    fi<br><br>    /usr/bin/clear<br>    echo "~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~"<br>    echo "        M A I N - M E N U"<br>    echo "  macOS Security Compliance Tool"<br>    echo "~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~"<br>    echo "Last compliance scan: $lastComplianceScan<br>"<br>    echo "1. View Last Compliance Report"<br>    echo "2. Run New Compliance Scan"<br>    echo "3. Run Commands to remediate non-compliant settings"<br>    echo "4. Exit"<br>}<br><br># function to read options<br>read_options(){<br>    local choice<br>    vared -p "Enter choice [ 1 - 4 ] " -c choice<br>    case $choice in<br>        1) view_report ;;<br>        2) run_scan ;;<br>        3) run_fix ;;<br>        4) exit 0;;<br>        *) echo -e "${RED}Error: please choose an option 1-4...${STD}" && sleep 1<br>    esac<br>}<br><br># function to reset and remove plist file. The name of our script<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/$appname"<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"<br><br># Check if the log directory has been created<br>if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then<br>    # Already created<br>    echo "$(date) \| Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>    # Creating Metadirectory<br>    echo "$(date) \| creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>    mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br># Functions<br># Enable Security Auditing on macOS Sonoma<br>EnableSecurityAuditing() {<br>    if [[ ! -e /etc/security/audit_control ]] && [[ -e /etc/security/audit_control.example ]];then<br>        /bin/cp /etc/security/audit_control.example /etc/security/audit_control<br>    fi<br><br>    /bin/launchctl enable system/com.apple.auditd<br>    /bin/launchctl bootstrap system /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.apple.auditd.plist<br>    /usr/sbin/audit -i<br>    echo  "$(date) \| Security Auditing is enabled for devices."<br>}<br><br># Ensuring access to audit records is controlled<br>ControlledAuditRecords() {<br>    /usr/sbin/chown -R root:wheel /etc/security/audit_control<br>    /bin/chmod -R o-rw /etc/security/audit_control<br>    /usr/sbin/chown -R root:wheel /var/audit/<br>    /bin/chmod -R o-rw /var/audit/<br>    echo  "$(date) \| Access to audit records is now controlled or already controlled."<br>}<br><br># Disable Bonjour Advertising Services<br>DisableBonjourAdvertisingServices() {<br>    /usr/bin/defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.apple.mDNSResponder.plist NoMulticastAdvertisements -bool true<br>    echo "$(date) \| Bonjour Advertising Services is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disable HTTP Server<br>DisableHTTPServer() {<br>    /usr/sbin/apachectl stop 2> /dev/null<br>    /bin/launchctl unload -w /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/org.apache.httpd.plist 2> /dev/null<br>    echo  "$(date) \| HTTP Server is disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disable NFS Server<br>DisableNFSServer() {<br>    /sbin/nfsd stop 2> /dev/null<br>    /bin/launchctl disable system/com.apple.nfsd 2> /dev/null<br><br>    # Removing the exported Directory listing<br>    /bin/rm /etc/exports 2> /dev/null<br>    echo  "$(date) \| NFS Server is disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Delete Guest Home Folder<br>DeleteGuestHomeFolder() {<br>    /bin/rm -R /Users/Guest 2> /dev/null<br>    echo "$(date) \| Guest Home Folder is deleted or already deleted."<br>}<br><br># Disables Guest Access to Shared Folders<br>DisableGuestAccessToSharedFolders() {<br>    /usr/sbin/sysadminctl -smbGuestAccess off<br>    echo "$(date) \| Guest Access to Shared Folders is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># First checking CPU architecture and then disables Power Nap if device is Intel Mac<br>DisablePowerNapForIntelMacs() {<br>    echo  "$(date) \| Detecting CPU architecture..."<br>    if [[ $(uname -m) == 'arm64' ]]; then<br>        # This is Apple Silicon. We don't need to run this script for these devices<br>        echo  "$(date) \| CPU architecture is Apple Silicon. We don't need to run this script for this CPU to disable Power Nap."<br>    else<br>        # Disables Power Nap for Intel Macs<br>        echo  "$(date) \| CPU architecture is Intel. Therefore, we need to make sure that Power Nap is disabled or already disabled. Applying needed changes..."<br>        /usr/bin/pmset -a powernap 0<br>        echo  "$(date) \| Power Nap is disabled or already disabled for your Intel Mac."<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Disables Printer Sharing<br>DisablePrinterSharing() {<br>    /usr/sbin/cupsctl --no-share-printers<br>    echo  "$(date) \| Printer Sharing is disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disables Remote Apple Events<br>DisableRemoteAppleEvents() {<br>    /usr/sbin/systemsetup -setremoteappleevents off 2> /dev/null<br>    echo "$(date) \| Remote Apple Events is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disables Remote Login<br>DisableRemoteLogin() {<br>    echo Yes \| /usr/sbin/systemsetup -setremotelogin off<br>    echo ""<br>    echo "$(date) \| Remote Login is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disables Remote Management<br>DisableRemoteManagement() {<br>    /System/Library/CoreServices/RemoteManagement/ARDAgent.app/Contents/Resources/kickstart -deactivate -stop<br>    echo "$(date) \| Remote Management will be fully disabled after reboot or is already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Disable SMB 1 and NetBIOS<br>DisableSMB1NetBIOSAndNetbiosd() {<br>    echo  "$(date) \| Disabling SMB1 and NetBIOS..."<br>    ## Check if "/etc/nsmb.conf" existed<br>    if [ -f "$file" ]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| $file exists. Let's proceed..."<br>        # Check if protocol_vers_map is set to a different number or missing<br>        ## Lock negotiation to SMB2/3 only<br>        ## 7 == 0111  SMB 1/2/3 should be enabled<br>        ## 6 == 0110  SMB 2/3 should be enabled<br>        ## 4 == 0100  SMB 3 should be enabled<br>        if grep -q "^protocol_vers_map=" "$file"; then<br>            current_value1=$(grep -E "^protocol_vers_map=" "$file" \| cut -d'=' -f2)<br>            if [ "$current_value1" != "6" ]; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| protocol_vers_map is set to $current_value1. Changing it to 6..."<br>                sed -i '' 's/^protocol_vers_map=.*/protocol_vers_map=6/' "$file"<br>            else<br>                echo "$(date) \| protocol_vers_map is already set to 6."<br>            fi<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| protocol_vers_map is missing. Adding it..."<br>            echo "protocol_vers_map=6" \| tee -a "$file" > /dev/null<br>        fi<br>        # Check if port445 is set to no_netbios or missing<br>        ## No SMB1, so we disable NetBIOS<br>        if grep -q "^port445=" "$file"; then<br>            current_value2=$(grep -E "^port445=" "$file" \| cut -d'=' -f2)<br>            if [ "$current_value2" != "no_netbios" ]; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| port445 is set to $current_value2. Changing it to no_netbios..."<br>                sed -i '' 's/^port445=.*/port445=no_netbios/' "$file"<br>            else<br>                echo "$(date) \| port445 is already set to no_netbios."<br>            fi<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| port445 is missing. Adding it..."<br>            echo "port445=no_netbios" \| tee -a "$file" > /dev/null<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        ## Creates /etc/nsmb.conf if not existed<br>        echo "$(date) \| $file does not exist. Creating file..."<br>        echo "[default]" \| tee -a $file > /dev/null<br>        ## Lock negotiation to SMB2/3 only<br>        ## 7 == 0111  SMB 1/2/3 should be enabled<br>        ## 6 == 0110  SMB 2/3 should be enabled<br>        ## 4 == 0100  SMB 3 should be enabled<br>        echo "protocol_vers_map=6" \| tee -a $file > /dev/null<br>        ## No SMB1, so we disable NetBIOS<br>        echo "port445=no_netbios" \| tee -a /etc/nsmb.conf > /dev/null<br>    fi<br><br>    ## Disable netbiosd name registration<br>    launchctl disable system/netbiosd 2> /dev/null<br>    launchctl unload -w /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.apple.netbiosd.plist 2> /dev/null<br>    echo  "$(date) \| SMB1, NetBIOS and netbiosd is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br>DisableScreenSharing() {<br>    /bin/launchctl disable system/com.apple.screensharing 2> /dev/null<br>    /bin/launchctl bootout system/com.apple.screensharing 2> /dev/null<br>    echo "$(date) \| Screen Sharing via VNC is now disabled or already disabled."<br>}<br><br># Enables "Show all filename extensions" -setting from Finder from current user<br>ShowAllFilenameExtensions() {<br>    defaults write NSGlobalDomain "AppleShowAllExtensions" -bool "true" && killall Finder<br>    echo "$(date) \| 'Show all filename extensions' -setting is now enabled or it is already enabled from Finder for user $USER."<br>}<br><br># Set to ensure an Administrator account cannot login to another user's active and locked session<br>EnableAppleMobileFileIntegrityAMFI() {<br>    /usr/sbin/nvram boot-args=""<br>    echo "$(date) \| Apple Mobile File Integrity (AMFI) is enabled or already enabled."<br>}<br><br># Set to ensure an Administrator account cannot login to another user's active and locked session<br>AdministratorAccountCannotLoginToAnotherUsersActiveAndLockedSession() {<br>    /usr/bin/security authorizationdb write system.login.screensaver use-login-window-ui<br>    echo "$(date) \| Administrator account cannot login to another user's active and locked session is now set or is already set."<br>}<br><br># Set to require an administrator password to access system-wide settings<br>AdministratorPasswordToSystemWidePreferences() {<br>    authDBs=("system.preferences" "system.preferences.energysaver" "system.preferences.network" "system.preferences.printing" "system.preferences.sharing" "system.preferences.softwareupdate" "system.preferences.startupdisk" "system.preferences.timemachine")<br>    for section in ${authDBs[@]}; do<br>        /usr/bin/security -q authorizationdb read "$section" > "/tmp/$section.plist" key_value=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print :shared" "/tmp/$section.plist" 2>&1)<br>        if [[ "$key_value" == *"Does Not Exist"* ]]; then<br>            /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :shared bool false" "/tmp/$section.plist"<br>        else   /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :shared false" "/tmp/$section.plist"<br>        fi<br>        /usr/bin/security -q authorizationdb write "$section" < "/tmp/$section.plist"<br>    done<br>    echo "$(date) \| Ensure an Administrator password is required to access system-wide Preferences is now set or already set."<br>}<br><br># Secure User's Home Folders<br>SecureUsersHomeFolders() {<br>    IFS=$'\n'<br>    for userDirs in $( /usr/bin/find /System/Volumes/Data/Users -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! \( -perm 700 -o -perm 711 \) \| /usr/bin/grep -v "Shared" \| /usr/bin/grep -v "Guest" ); do<br>        /bin/chmod og-rwx "$userDirs"<br>    done<br>    unset IFS<br>    echo  "$(date) \| User's Home Folders are now secured or already secured."<br>}<br><br># Start logging<br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br><br># Begin Script Body<br>echo ""<br>echo |Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/zsh<br>#<br># Intune shell script: downloads the latest Intune Log Watch release DMG and installs<br># IntuneLogWatch.app into /Applications. Intended to run as root via Intune shell scripts.<br><br>set -euo pipefail<br><br># Configurable variables<br>APP_NAME="IntuneLogWatch.app"<br>DMG_NAME="IntuneLogWatch.dmg"<br>DOWNLOAD_DIR="/tmp"<br>INSTALL_DIR="/Applications"<br>GITHUB_RELEASES_API="https://api.github.com/repos/gilburns/IntuneLogWatch/releases/latest"<br><br># Runtime state<br>MOUNT_POINT=""<br><br>log() {<br>  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"<br>}<br><br>cleanup() {<br>  if [[ -n "$MOUNT_POINT" && -d "$MOUNT_POINT" ]]; then<br>    log "Detaching $MOUNT_POINT"<br>    hdiutil detach "$MOUNT_POINT" -quiet \|\| true<br>    rmdir "$MOUNT_POINT" 2>/dev/null \|\| true<br>  fi<br>  if [[ -f "$DOWNLOAD_DIR/$DMG_NAME" ]]; then<br>    log "Removing $DOWNLOAD_DIR/$DMG_NAME"<br>    rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DIR/$DMG_NAME"<br>  fi<br>}<br>trap cleanup EXIT<br><br>log "Resolving latest Intune Log Watch DMG URL from GitHub..."<br>DMG_URL="$(curl -s "$GITHUB_RELEASES_API" \<br>  \| grep browser_download_url \<br>  \| grep '.dmg"' \<br>  \| cut -d '"' -f 4)"<br><br>if [[ -z "$DMG_URL" ]]; then<br>  log "ERROR: Could not determine DMG download URL from GitHub."<br>  exit 1<br>fi<br><br>log "Downloading DMG from: $DMG_URL"<br>curl -L -o "$DOWNLOAD_DIR/$DMG_NAME" "$DMG_URL"<br><br>log "Mounting DMG..."<br>MOUNT_POINT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/ilw.XXXXXX)"<br>if ! hdiutil attach "$DOWNLOAD_DIR/$DMG_NAME" -nobrowse -quiet -mountpoint "$MOUNT_POINT"; then<br>  log "ERROR: Failed to mount DMG."<br>  exit 1<br>fi<br><br>log "Copying $APP_NAME to $INSTALL_DIR..."<br>if [[ -d "$INSTALL_DIR/$APP_NAME" ]]; then<br>  log "Existing copy found, removing $INSTALL_DIR/$APP_NAME"<br>  rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR/$APP_NAME"<br>fi<br><br>if [[ -d "$MOUNT_POINT/$APP_NAME" ]]; then<br>  SOURCE_APP="$MOUNT_POINT/$APP_NAME"<br>else<br>  SOURCE_APP="$(find "$MOUNT_POINT" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name "$APP_NAME" 2>/dev/null \| head -n 1)"<br>fi<br><br>if [[ -z "$SOURCE_APP" \|\| ! -d "$SOURCE_APP" ]]; then<br>  log "ERROR: Could not find $APP_NAME in the mounted DMG."<br>  exit 1<br>fi<br><br>ditto "$SOURCE_APP" "$INSTALL_DIR/$APP_NAME"<br><br>log "Intune Log Watch installed to $INSTALL_DIR/$APP_NAME"<br><br></details>|

### REF_MAC_D_CO_SS_APP_PPPCUtil
Description: PPPC Utility is a macOS \(10\.15 and newer\) application for creating configuration profiles containing the Privacy Preferences Policy Control payload for macOS\. The profiles can be saved locally, signed or unsigned\.

https://github.com/jamf/pppc-utility

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/zsh<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## Script to install the latest PPPC Utility<br>##<br>## VER 4.0.0<br>##<br>## Change Log<br>##<br>## 2022-06-24   - First re-write in ZSH<br>## 2022-06-20   - Fixed terminate process function bugs<br>## 2022-02-28   - Updated file type detection logic where we can't tell what the file is by filename in downloadApp function<br>## 2022-02-23   - Added detection support for bz2 and tbz2<br>## 2022-02-11   - Added detection support for mpkg<br>## 2022-01-05   - Updated Rosetta detection code<br>## 2021-11-19   - Added logic to handle both APP and PKG inside DMG file. New function DMGPKG<br>## 2021-12-06   - Added --compressed to curl cli<br>##              - Fixed DMGPKG detection<br>##<br>############################################################################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp.
