In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br><br># User Defined variables<br>PPPCLatestURL="https://github.com/jamf/PPPC-Utility/releases/latest"<br>versionUrl=$(curl "${PPPCLatestURL}" -s -L -I -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}')<br>versionNumber=$(printf "%s" "${versionUrl[@]}" \| sed 's@.*/@@' \| sed 's/%20/-/g')<br>weburl="https://github.com/jamf/PPPC-Utility/releases/download/$versionNumber/PPPC-Utility.zip"<br>appname="PPPC Utility"                                             # The name of our App deployment script (also used for Octory monitor)<br>app="$appname.app"                                                 # The actual name of our App once installed<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/$appname"     # The location of our logs and last updated data<br>processpath="/Applications/Utilities/$app/Contents/MacOS/$appname" # The process name of the App we are installing<br>terminateprocess="true"                                            # Do we want to terminate the running process? If false we'll wait until its not running<br>autoUpdate="false"                                                 # Application updates itself, if already installed we should exit<br><br># Generated variables<br>tempdir=$(mktemp -d)<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"       # The location of the script log file<br>metafile="$logandmetadir/$appname.meta" # The location of our meta file (for updates)<br><br># function to delay script if the specified process is running<br>waitForProcess() {<br><br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    ##<br>    ##  Function to pause while a specified process is running<br>    ##<br>    ##  Functions used<br>    ##<br>    ##      None<br>    ##<br>    ##  Variables used<br>    ##<br>    ##      $1 = name of process to check for<br>    ##      $2 = length of delay (if missing, function to generate random delay between 10 and 60s)<br>    ##      $3 = true/false if = "true" terminate process, if "false" wait for it to close<br>    ##<br>    ###############################################################<br>    ###############################################################<br><br>    processName=$1<br>    fixedDelay=$2<br>    terminate=$3<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Waiting for other [$processName] processes to end"<br>    while ps aux \| grep "$processName" \| grep -v grep &>/dev/null; do<br><br>        if [[ $terminate == "true" ]]; then<br>            pid=$(ps -fe \| grep "$processName" \| grep -v grep \| awk '{print $2}')<br>            echo "$(date) \| + [$appname] running, terminating [$processName] at pid [$pid]..."<br>            kill -9 $pid<br>            return<br>        fi<br><br>        # If we've been passed a delay we should use it, otherwise we'll create a random delay each run<br>        if [[ ! $fixedDelay ]]; then<br>            delay=$(($RANDOM % 50 + 10))<br>        else<br>            delay=$fixedDelay<br>        fi<br><br>        echo "$(date) \|  + Another instance of $processName is running, waiting [$delay] seconds"<br>        sleep $delay<br>    done<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| No instances of [$processName] found, safe to proceed"<br><br>}<br><br># function to check if we need Rosetta 2<br>checkForRosetta2() {<br><br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    ##<br>    ##  Simple function to install Rosetta 2 if needed.<br>    ##<br>    ##  Functions<br>    ##<br>    ##      waitForProcess (used to pause script if another instance of softwareupdate is running)<br>    ##<br>    ##  Variables<br>    ##<br>    ##      None<br>    ##<br>    ###############################################################<br>    ###############################################################<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Checking if we need Rosetta 2 or not"<br><br>    # if Software update is already running, we need to wait...<br>    waitForProcess "/usr/sbin/softwareupdate"<br><br>    ## Note, Rosetta detection code from https://derflounder.wordpress.com/2020/11/17/installing-rosetta-2-on-apple-silicon-macs/<br>    OLDIFS=$IFS<br>    IFS='.' read osvers_major osvers_minor osvers_dot_version <<<"$(/usr/bin/sw_vers -productVersion)"<br>    IFS=$OLDIFS<br><br>    if [[ ${osvers_major} -ge 11 ]]; then<br><br>        # Check to see if the Mac needs Rosetta installed by testing the processor<br><br>        processor=$(/usr/sbin/sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string \| grep -o "Intel")<br><br>        if [[ -n "$processor" ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| $processor processor installed. No need to install Rosetta."<br>        else<br><br>            # Check for Rosetta "oahd" process. If not found,<br>            # perform a non-interactive install of Rosetta.<br><br>            if /usr/bin/pgrep oahd >/dev/null 2>&1; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| Rosetta is already installed and running. Nothing to do."<br>            else<br>                /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license<br><br>                if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Rosetta has been successfully installed."<br>                else<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Rosetta installation failed!"<br>                    exitcode=1<br>                fi<br>            fi<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Mac is running macOS $osvers_major.$osvers_minor.$osvers_dot_version."<br>        echo "$(date) \| No need to install Rosetta on this version of macOS."<br>    fi<br><br>}<br><br># Function to update the last modified date for this app<br>fetchLastModifiedDate() {<br><br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    ##<br>    ##  This function takes the following global variables and downloads the URL provided to a temporary location<br>    ##<br>    ##  Functions<br>    ##<br>    ##      none<br>    ##<br>    ##  Variables<br>    ##<br>    ##      $logandmetadir = Directory to read nand write meta data to<br>    ##      $metafile = Location of meta file (used to store last update time)<br>    ##      $weburl = URL of download location<br>    ##      $tempfile = location of temporary DMG file downloaded<br>    ##      $lastmodified = Generated by the function as the last-modified http header from the curl request<br>    ##<br>    ##  Notes<br>    ##<br>    ##      If called with "fetchLastModifiedDate update" the function will overwrite the current lastmodified date into metafile<br>    ##<br>    ###############################################################<br>    ###############################################################<br><br>    ## Check if the log directory has been created<br>    if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then<br>        ## Creating Metadirectory<br>        echo "$(date) \| Creating [$logandmetadir] to store metadata"<br>        mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"<br>    fi<br><br>    # generate the last modified date of the file we need to download<br>    lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$weburl" \| grep -i "last-modified" \| awk '{$1=""; print $0}' \| awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' \| tr -d '\r')<br><br>    if [[ $1 == "update" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Writing last modifieddate [$lastmodified] to [$metafile]"<br>        echo "$lastmodified" >"$metafile"<br>    fi<br><br>}<br><br>function downloadApp() {<br><br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    #################################################################################################################<br>    ##<br>    ##  This function takes the following global variables and downloads the URL provided to a temporary location<br>    ##<br>    ##  Functions<br>    ##<br>    ##      waitForCurl (Pauses download until all other instances of Curl have finished)<br>    ##      downloadSize (Generates human readable size of the download for the logs)<br>    ##<br>    ##  Variables<br>    ##<br>    ##      $appname = Description of the App we are installing<br>    ##      $weburl = URL of download location<br>    ##      $tempfile = location of temporary DMG file downloaded<br>    ##<br>    ###############################################################<br>    ###############################################################<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Starting downlading of [$appname]"<br><br>    # wait for other downloads to complete<br>    waitForProcess "curl -f"<br><br>    #download the file<br>    updateOctory installing<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloading $appname [$weburl]"<br><br>    cd "$tempdir"<br>    curl -f -s --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 --compressed -L -J -O "$weburl"<br>    if [[ $? == 0 ]]; then<br><br>        # We have downloaded a file, we need to know what the file is called and what type of file it is<br>        #tempSearchPath="$tempdir/*"<br>        for f in *; do<br>            tempfile=$f<br>            echo "$(date) \| Found downloaded tempfile [$tempfile]"<br>        done<br><br>        case $tempfile in<br><br>        *.pkg \| *.PKG \| *.mpkg \| *.MPKG)<br>            packageType="PKG"<br>            ;;<br><br>        *.zip \| *.ZIP)<br>            packageType="ZIP"<br>            ;;<br><br>        *.tbz2 \| *.TBZ2 \| *.bz2 \| *.BZ2)<br>            packageType="BZ2"<br>            ;;<br><br>        *.dmg \| *.DMG)<br><br>            packageType="DMG"<br>            ;;<br><br>        *)<br>            # We can't tell what this is by the file name, lets look at the metadata<br>            echo "$(date) \| Unknown file type [$f], analysing metadata"<br>            metadata=$(file -z "$tempfile")<br><br>            echo "$(date) \| [DEBUG ] File metadata [$metadata]"<br><br>            if [[ "$metadata" == *"Zip archive data"* ]]; then<br>                packageType="ZIP"<br>                mv "$tempfile" "$tempdir/install.zip"<br>                tempfile="$tempdir/install.zip"<br>            fi<br><br>            if [[ "$metadata" == *"xar archive"* ]]; then<br>                packageType="PKG"<br>                mv "$tempfile" "$tempdir/install.pkg"<br>                tempfile="$tempdir/install.pkg"<br>            fi<br><br>            if [[ "$metadata" == *"DOS/MBR boot sector, extended partition table"* ]] \|\| [[ "$metadata" == *"Apple Driver Map"* ]]; then<br>                packageType="DMG"<br>                mv "$tempfile" "$tempdir/install.dmg"<br>                tempfile="$tempdir/install.dmg"<br>            fi<br><br>            if [[ "$metadata" == *"POSIX tar archive (bzip2 compressed data"* ]]; then<br>                packageType="BZ2"<br>                mv "$tempfile" "$tempdir/install.tar.bz2"<br>                tempfile="$tempdir/install.tar.bz2"<br>            fi<br>            ;;<br>        esac<br><br>        if [[ "$packageType" == "DMG" ]]; then<br>            # We have what we think is a DMG, but we don't know what is inside it yet, could be an APP or PKG or ZIP<br>            # Let's mount it and try to guess what we're dealing with...<br>            echo "$(date) \| Found DMG, looking inside..."<br><br>            # Mount the dmg file...<br>            volume="$tempdir/$appname"<br>            echo "$(date) \| Mounting Image [$volume] [$tempfile]"<br>            hdiutil attach -quiet -nobrowse -mountpoint "$volume" "$tempfile"<br>            if [[ "$?" = "0" ]]; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| Mounted succesfully to [$volume]"<br>            else<br>                echo "$(date) \| Failed to mount [$tempfile]"<br><br>            fi<br><br>            if [[ $(ls "$volume" \| grep -i .app) ]] && [[ $(ls "$volume" \| grep -i .pkg) ]]; then<br><br>                echo "$(date) \| Detected both APP and PKG in same DMG, exiting gracefully"<br><br>            else<br><br>                if [[ $(ls "$volume" \| grep -i .app) ]]; then<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Detected APP, setting PackageType to DMG"<br>                    packageType="DMG"<br>                fi<br><br>                if [[ $(ls "$volume" \| grep -i .pkg) ]]; then<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Detected PKG, setting PackageType to DMGPKG"<br>                    packageType="DMGPKG"<br>                fi<br><br>                if [[ $(ls "$volume" \| grep -i .mpkg) ]]; then<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Detected PKG, setting PackageType to DMGPKG"<br>                    packageType="DMGPKG"<br>                fi<br><br>            fi<br><br>            # Unmount the dmg<br>            echo "$(date) \| Un-mounting [$volume]"<br>            hdiutil detach -quiet "$volume"<br>        fi<br><br>        if [[ ! $packageType ]]; then<br>            echo "Failed to determine temp file type [$metadata]"<br>            rm -rf "$tempdir"<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| Downloaded [$app] to [$tempfile]"<br>            echo "$(date) \| Detected install type as [$packageType]"<br>        fi<br><br>    else<br><br>        echo "$(date) \| Failure to download [$weburl] to [$tempfile]"<br>        updateOctory failed<br><br>        exit 1<br>    fi<br><br>}<br><br># Function to check if we need to update or not<br>function updateCheck() {<br><br> /Applications<br>    ##<br>    ###############################################################<br>    ###############################################################<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Checking if we need to install or update [$appname]"<br><br>    ## Is the app already installed?<br>    if [ -d "/Applications/Utilities/$app" ]; then<br><br>        # App is installed, if it's then<br><br>            if [ -f "$metafile" ]; then<br>                previouslastmodifieddate=$(cat "$metafile")<br>                if [[ "$previouslastmodifieddate" != "$lastmodified" ]]; then<br> echo "$(date) \| No update between previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"<br>                    echo "$(date) \| Exiting, nothing to do"<br>                    exit 0<br>                fi<br>            else<br>                echo "$(date) \| Meta file [$metafile] not found"<br>                echo "$(date) \| Unable to determine if update required, updating [$appname] ### REF_MAC_D_CO_SS_DockSettings_Shared
Description: Company Portal is not added to the dock\.
This script is designed to wait for specific applications to be installed on a Mac before configuring the Mac Dock with those applications\. The script includes options to use either dockutil or direct manipulation of the Dock's plist file for configuring the Dock\. Below is a detailed guide on how to use the script and explanations of the available options\. 

https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/tree/master/macOS/Config/Dock

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## Script to wait for apps to be installed and then configure the Mac Dock<br>##<br>###########################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br><br>useDockUtil=true<br>waitForApps=true<br><br># Hold script until Dock is running, otherwise we might run under _mbsetupuser which would be bad<br>until pgrep -x "Dock" &>/dev/null; do<br>    sleep 10<br>done<br><br>currentUser=$( scutil <<< "show State:/Users/ConsoleUser" \| awk '/Name :/ { print $3 }' )<br><br># Get uid logged in user<br>uid=$(id -u "${currentUser}")<br><br># Current User home folder - do it this way in case the folder isn't in /Users<br>userHome=$(dscl . -read /users/${currentUser} NFSHomeDirectory \| cut -d " " -f 2)<br><br># Logging folder and files<br>logFolder="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/addAppstoDock"<br>log=${logFolder}/addAppstoDock.log<br>mkdir -p "$logFolder"<br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br><br># Path to plist<br>plist="${userHome}/Library/Preferences/com.apple.dock.plist"<br><br># Determine the correct settings app<br>if [[ -e "/System/Applications/System Settings.app" ]]; then<br>    settingsApp="System Settings.app"<br>else<br>    settingsApp="System Preferences.app"<br>fi<br><br># Determine the LaunchPad app<br>if [[ -e "/System/Applications/Apps.app" ]]; then<br>    LaunchPadApp="Apps.app"<br>else<br>    LaunchPadApp="Launchpad.app"<br>fi<br><br>dockApps=(  "/System/Applications/$LaunchPadApp"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Edge.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Outlook.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Word.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Excel.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft PowerPoint.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft OneNote.app"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Teams.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Remote Help.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Company Portal.app"<br>            "/Library/Application Support/Microsoft/MAU2.0/Microsoft AutoUpdate.app"<br>            #"/System/Applications/App Store.app"<br>            #"/System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app"<br>            "/System/Applications/$settingsApp")<br><br>install_dockutil_if_missing() {<br>    # Check if dockutil is installed<br>    if [[ ! -e "/usr/local/bin/dockutil" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| dockutil is not present, installing"<br><br>    # Download dockutil package<br>        if curl -L "https://github.com/kcrawford/dockutil/releases/download/3.1.3/dockutil-3.1.3.pkg" -o /var/tmp/dockutil.pkg; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Successfully downloaded dockutil.pkg"<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| Failed to download dockutil.pkg"<br>        return 1<br>    fi<br><br>    # Install dockutil package<br>    if sudo installer -pkg /var/tmp/dockutil.pkg -target /; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Successfully installed dockutil"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Failed to install dockutil"<br>        return 1<br>    fi<br><br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| dockutil is already present"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Convenience function to run a command as the current user<br># usage: run_as_user command arguments...<br>run_as_user() {<br>  if [[ "${currentUser}" != "loginwindow" ]]; then<br>    launchctl asuser "$uid" sudo -u "${currentUser}" "$@"<br>  else<br>    echo "no user logged in"<br>    exit 1<br>  fi<br>}<br><br>configure_dock_with_dockutil () {<br><br>    dockutil="/usr/local/bin/dockutil"<br><br>    # Clear Dock<br>    run_as_user "${dockutil}" --remove all --no-restart ${plist}<br><br>    # Add Apps to Dock in order<br>    for app in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>        if [[ -e "$app" ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Adding ${app} to Dock..."<br>            run_as_user "${dockutil}" --add "${app}" --section apps --no-restart ${plist} > /dev/null 2>&1<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| ${app} not installed, skipping..."<br>        fi<br>    done<br><br>    # Add Downloads Folder<br>    run_as_user "${dockutil}" --add "${userHome}/Downloads" --section others --no-restart ${plist} > /dev/null 2>&1<br><br>    killall -KILL Dock<br><br>    touch "/Users/$currentUser/Library/Preferences/.dockconfigured"<br>}<br><br>configure_dock_via_plist () {<br><br>    # Clearing Dock<br>    echo "$(date) \|  Removing Dock Persistent Apps"<br>    #run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock<br>    run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock persistent-apps<br>    run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock persistent-others<br><br>    echo "$(date) \|  Adding Apps to Dock"<br>    for i in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>        if [[ -a "$i" ]] ; then<br>        echo "$(date) \|  Adding [$i] to Dock"<br>        run_as_user defaults write com.apple.dock persistent-apps -array-add "<dict><key>tile-data</key><dict><key>file-data</key><dict><key>_CFURLString</key><string>$i</string><key>_CFURLStringType</key><integer>0</integer></dict></dict></dict>"<br>        fi<br>    done<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Adding Downloads Stack"<br>    downloadfolder="${userHome}/Downloads"<br>    run_as_user defaults write com.apple.dock persistent-others -array-add "<dict><key>tile-data</key><dict><key>file-data</key><dict><key>_CFURLString</key><string>$downloadfolder</string><key>_CFURLStringType</key><integer>0</integer></dict><key>file-label</key><string>Downloads</string><key>file-type</key><string>2</string></dict><key>tile-type</key><string>directory-tile</string></dict>"<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enabling Magnification"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock magnification -boolean YES<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Dim Hidden Apps in Dock"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock showhidden -bool true<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Auto Hide dock"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock autohide -bool true<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Disable show recent items"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock show-recents -bool FALSE<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Minimise Icons into Dock Icons"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock minimize-to-application -bool yes<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Restarting Dock"<br>    killall -KILL Dock<br><br>    touch "/Users/$currentUser/Library/Preferences/.dockconfigured"<br><br>}<br><br>wait_for_apps_installation() {<br>    local timeout=$1<br>    local start_time=$(date +%s)<br>    while true; do<br>        all_installed=true<br><br>        for app in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>            if [[ ! -e "$app" ]]; then<br>                all_installed=false<br>                break<br>            fi<br>        done<br><br>        if [[ "$all_installed" = true ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| All apps are installed"<br>            return 0<br>        fi<br><br>        current_time=$(date +%s)<br>        elapsed_time=$(( current_time - start_time ))<br><br>        if [[ $elapsed_time -ge $timeout ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Timeout reached. Not all apps are installed."<br>            return 1<br>        fi<br><br>        sleep 5 # Sleep for a few seconds before checking again<br>    done<br>}<br><br>## Script Begins Here<br><br># Check if apps are installed<br>if [[ "$waitForApps" == true ]]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Waiting for apps to be installed..."<br>    wait_for_apps_installation 900      # Wait 900 seconds for apps to be installed<br>fi<br><br># if useDockUtil is true, use dockutil to configure the dock<br>if [[ "$useDockUtil" == true ]]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Configuring dock with dockutil"<br>    install_dockutil_if_missing<br>    configure_dock_with_dockutil<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Configuring dock with plist"<br>    configure_dock_via_plist<br>fi</details>|

### REF_MAC_D_CO_SS_DockSettings_UserAffinity
Description: This script is designed to wait for specific applications to be installed on a Mac before configuring the Mac Dock with those applications\. The script includes options to use either dockutil or direct manipulation of the Dock's plist file for configuring the Dock\. Below is a detailed guide on how to use the script and explanations of the available options\.

https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/tree/master/macOS/Config/Dock
#### Assignments
|intent |  target   |filter type|filter name|
|-------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
|Include|All Devices|none       |           |

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br>############################################################################################<br>##<br>## Script to wait for apps to be installed and then configure the Mac Dock<br>##<br>###########################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br><br>useDockUtil=true<br>waitForApps=true<br><br># Hold script until Dock is running, otherwise we might run under _mbsetupuser which would be bad<br>until pgrep -x "Dock" &>/dev/null; do<br>    sleep 10<br>done<br><br>currentUser=$( scutil <<< "show State:/Users/ConsoleUser" \| awk '/Name :/ { print $3 }' )<br><br># Get uid logged in user<br>uid=$(id -u "${currentUser}")<br><br># Current User home folder - do it this way in case the folder isn't in /Users<br>userHome=$(dscl . -read /users/${currentUser} NFSHomeDirectory \| cut -d " " -f 2)<br><br># Logging folder and files<br>logFolder="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/addAppstoDock"<br>log=${logFolder}/addAppstoDock.log<br>mkdir -p "$logFolder"<br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br><br># Path to plist<br>plist="${userHome}/Library/Preferences/com.apple.dock.plist"<br><br># Determine the correct settings app<br>if [[ -e "/System/Applications/System Settings.app" ]]; then<br>    settingsApp="System Settings.app"<br>else<br>    settingsApp="System Preferences.app"<br>fi<br><br># Determine the LaunchPad app<br>if [[ -e "/System/Applications/Apps.app" ]]; then<br>    LaunchPadApp="Apps.app"<br>else<br>    LaunchPadApp="Launchpad.app"<br>fi<br><br>dockApps=(  "/System/Applications/$LaunchPadApp"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Edge.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Outlook.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Word.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft Excel.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft PowerPoint.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Microsoft OneNote.app"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Teams.app"<br>            #"/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app"<br>            "/Applications/Microsoft Remote Help.app"<br>            "/Applications/Company Portal.app"<br>            "/Library/Application Support/Microsoft/MAU2.0/Microsoft AutoUpdate.app"<br>            #"/System/Applications/App Store.app"<br>            #"/System/Applications/Utilities/Terminal.app"<br>            "/System/Applications/$settingsApp")<br><br>install_dockutil_if_missing() {<br>    # Check if dockutil is installed<br>    if [[ ! -e "/usr/local/bin/dockutil" ]]; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| dockutil is not present, installing"<br><br>    # Download dockutil package<br>        if curl -L "https://github.com/kcrawford/dockutil/releases/download/3.1.3/dockutil-3.1.3.pkg" -o /var/tmp/dockutil.pkg; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Successfully downloaded dockutil.pkg"<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| Failed to download dockutil.pkg"<br>        return 1<br>    fi<br><br>    # Install dockutil package<br>    if sudo installer -pkg /var/tmp/dockutil.pkg -target /; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| Successfully installed dockutil"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| Failed to install dockutil"<br>        return 1<br>    fi<br><br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| dockutil is already present"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Convenience function to run a command as the current user<br># usage: run_as_user command arguments...<br>run_as_user() {<br>  if [[ "${currentUser}" != "loginwindow" ]]; then<br>    launchctl asuser "$uid" sudo -u "${currentUser}" "$@"<br>  else<br>    echo "no user logged in"<br>    exit 1<br>  fi<br>}<br><br>configure_dock_with_dockutil () {<br><br>    dockutil="/usr/local/bin/dockutil"<br><br>    # Clear Dock<br>    run_as_user "${dockutil}" --remove all --no-restart ${plist}<br><br>    # Add Apps to Dock in order<br>    for app in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>        if [[ -e "$app" ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Adding ${app} to Dock..."<br>            run_as_user "${dockutil}" --add "${app}" --section apps --no-restart ${plist} > /dev/null 2>&1<br>        else<br>            echo "$(date) \| ${app} not installed, skipping..."<br>        fi<br>    done<br><br>    # Add Downloads Folder<br>    run_as_user "${dockutil}" --add "${userHome}/Downloads" --section others --no-restart ${plist} > /dev/null 2>&1<br><br>    killall -KILL Dock<br><br>    touch "/Users/$currentUser/Library/Preferences/.dockconfigured"<br>}<br><br>configure_dock_via_plist () {<br><br>    # Clearing Dock<br>    echo "$(date) \|  Removing Dock Persistent Apps"<br>    #run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock<br>    run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock persistent-apps<br>    run_as_user defaults delete com.apple.dock persistent-others<br><br>    echo "$(date) \|  Adding Apps to Dock"<br>    for i in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>        if [[ -a "$i" ]] ; then<br>        echo "$(date) \|  Adding [$i] to Dock"<br>        run_as_user defaults write com.apple.dock persistent-apps -array-add "<dict><key>tile-data</key><dict><key>file-data</key><dict><key>_CFURLString</key><string>$i</string><key>_CFURLStringType</key><integer>0</integer></dict></dict></dict>"<br>        fi<br>    done<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Adding Downloads Stack"<br>    downloadfolder="${userHome}/Downloads"<br>    run_as_user defaults write com.apple.dock persistent-others -array-add "<dict><key>tile-data</key><dict><key>file-data</key><dict><key>_CFURLString</key><string>$downloadfolder</string><key>_CFURLStringType</key><integer>0</integer></dict><key>file-label</key><string>Downloads</string><key>file-type</key><string>2</string></dict><key>tile-type</key><string>directory-tile</string></dict>"<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enabling Magnification"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock magnification -boolean YES<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Dim Hidden Apps in Dock"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock showhidden -bool true<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Auto Hide dock"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock autohide -bool true<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Disable show recent items"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock show-recents -bool FALSE<br><br>    #echo "$(date) \| Enable Minimise Icons into Dock Icons"<br>    #defaults write com.apple.dock minimize-to-application -bool yes<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Restarting Dock"<br>    killall -KILL Dock<br><br>    touch "/Users/$currentUser/Library/Preferences/.dockconfigured"<br><br>}<br><br>wait_for_apps_installation() {<br>    local timeout=$1<br>    local start_time=$(date +%s)<br>    while true; do<br>        all_installed=true<br><br>        for app in "${dockApps[@]}"; do<br>            if [[ ! -e "$app" ]]; then<br>                all_installed=false<br>                break<br>            fi<br>        done<br><br>        if [[ "$all_installed" = true ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| All apps are installed"<br>            return 0<br>        fi<br><br>        current_time=$(date +%s)<br>        elapsed_time=$(( current_time - start_time ))<br><br>        if [[ $elapsed_time -ge $timeout ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| Timeout reached. Not all apps are installed."<br>            return 1<br>        fi<br><br>        sleep 5 # Sleep for a few seconds before checking again<br>    done<br>}<br><br>## Script Begins Here<br><br># Check if apps are installed<br>if [[ "$waitForApps" == true ]]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Waiting for apps to be installed..."<br>    wait_for_apps_installation 900      # Wait 900 seconds for apps to be installed<br>fi<br><br># if useDockUtil is true, use dockutil to configure the dock<br>if [[ "$useDockUtil" == true ]]; then<br>    echo "$(date) \| Configuring dock with dockutil"<br>    install_dockutil_if_missing<br>    configure_dock_with_dockutil<br>else<br>    echo "$(date) \| Configuring dock with plist"<br>    configure_dock_via_plist<br>fi</details>|

### REF_MAC_D_CO_SS_HideCompanyPortal
Description: Hides Company Portal app on Shared devices to stop users launching it from Applications and being prompted to register the device\.

Platform SSO configuration must support Enable Registration During Setup set to true\.
#### Configuration
|           setting           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|-----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|Execution Frequency          |P1D                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|Block Execution Notifications|False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|Display Name                 |REF_MAC_D_CO_SS_HideCompanyPortal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br>#set -x<br><br># User Defined variables<br>appName="Company Portal"<br>appPath="/Applications/$appName.app"<br><br># script variables<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/$appName"<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appName.log"<br>plistFile="/.Spotlight-V100/VolumeConfiguration.plist"<br><br><br># logging<br>if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then<br>  ## Creating Metadirectory<br>  echo "$(date) \| Creating [$logandmetadir] to store logs"<br>  mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"<br>fi<br><br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Logging hiding of [$appName] to [$log]"<br>echo "############################################################"<br>echo ""<br><br>echo "$(date) \| Checking if [$appName] app exists at [$appPath]"<br>if [ -d "$appPath" ]; then<br>  echo "$(date) \| Hiding [$appName] app at [$appPath]"<br>  chflags hidden "$appPath"<br><br>  # Add the hidden [$appName] app to Spotlight's global exclusion list<br>  echo "$(date) \| Adding [$appName] app to Spotlight's global exclusion list"<br>  sudo defaults write "$plistFile" Exclusions -array-add "$appPath"<br><br>  # clears the Spotlight index for the specified path, forcing it to reindex and apply the exclusion<br>  echo "$(date) \| Clearing Spotlight index for [$appPath] to apply exclusion"<br>  sudo mdutil -E "$appPath"<br><br>  # Restart the Spotlight process to apply changes immediately<br>  echo "$(date) \| Restarting Spotlight process to apply changes immediately"<br>  /usr/bin/killall mds<br>  exit 0<br><br>else<br>  echo "$(date) \| [$appName] not found at [$appPath]. Exiting script."<br>  exit 0<br>fi<br><br><br><br><br></details>|

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br><br># Description: Block Homebrew on Intune managed macOS devices<br># Author: Ugur Koc, @ugurkocde<br><br>appname="blockHomebrew" # The name of our App deployment script                                           # The actual name of our App once installed<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/$appname"<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"<br><br>## Check if the log directory has been created<br>if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then<br>    ## Already created<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>    ## Creating Metadirectory<br>    echo "# $(date) \| creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>    mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br># start logging<br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br><br># Set the path to the Homebrew installation<br>CPU_TYPE=$(sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string)<br>if [[ "$CPU_TYPE" == *"Apple"* ]]; then<br>    HOMEBREW_PATH="/opt/homebrew"<br>else<br>    HOMEBREW_PATH="/usr/local"<br>fi<br><br># Check if Homebrew directory exists<br>if [ -d "$HOMEBREW_PATH" ]; then<br>    echo "# $(date) \| $HOMEBREW_PATH exists. Uninstalling Homebrew and setting permissions."<br>    # Uninstall Homebrew<br>    NONINTERACTIVE=1 /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/uninstall.sh)"<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Homebrew uninstalled."<br>    # Change ownership to root and set permissions to root only<br>    sudo chown -R root:wheel "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>    sudo chmod -R 700 "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>else<br>    echo "# $(date) \| $HOMEBREW_PATH does not exist. Creating directory and setting permissions."<br>    # Create the directory and set ownership and permissions<br>    sudo mkdir -p "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>    sudo chown -R root:wheel "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>    sudo chmod -R 700 "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>fi<br><br># Change ownership to root and set permissions to root only<br>sudo chown -R root:wheel "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br>sudo chmod -R 700 "$HOMEBREW_PATH"<br><br># Alias message<br>alias_message="echo 'Brew is disabled on this managed device to avoid conflicts with patch management.'"<br><br># Function to add alias to a shell profile<br>add_alias_to_profile() {<br>    profile_path=$1<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Checking $profile_path"<br><br>    # Check if the profile file exists and is writable<br>    if [[ -w "$profile_path" ]]; then<br>        echo "# $(date) \| Adding alias to $profile_path"<br><br>        # Check if alias already exists in the profile<br>        if ! grep -q "alias brew=" "$profile_path"; then<br>            # Add alias<br>            echo "# $(date) \| alias brew=$alias_message" >>"$profile_path"<br>        else<br>            echo "# $(date) \| Alias already exists in $profile_path"<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        echo "# $(date) \| $profile_path not found or not writable."<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Add the sudoers configuration to restrict chmod on Homebrew directory<br>add_sudoers_restriction() {<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Attempting to add sudoers restriction for Homebrew directory"<br><br>    # Define the command alias and restriction<br>    sudoers_content="Cmnd_Alias HOMEBREW_CHMOD = /bin/chmod * /opt/homebrew*, /usr/bin/chmod * /opt/homebrew*\n%admin ALL=(ALL) ALL, !HOMEBREW_CHMOD"<br><br>    # Create a temporary file for safe sudoers editing<br>    tmp_sudoers=$(mktemp)<br><br>    # Check if tmp_sudoers is created<br>    if [[ -f "$tmp_sudoers" ]]; then<br>        # Add the current sudoers file to the temporary file<br>        sudo cat /etc/sudoers >"$tmp_sudoers"<br><br>        # Add the new restrictions to the temporary file<br>        echo -e "$sudoers_content" >>"$tmp_sudoers"<br><br>        # Check for syntax errors and update the sudoers file if none are found<br>        sudo visudo -cf "$tmp_sudoers" && sudo cp "$tmp_sudoers" /etc/sudoers && echo "# $(date) \| Sudoers file updated successfully."<br><br>        # Clean up the temporary file<br>        rm "$tmp_sudoers"<br>    else<br>        echo "# $(date) \| Failed to create temporary sudoers file."<br>    fi<br>}<br><br># Paths to user profiles for Bash and Zsh<br>BASH_PROFILE="$HOME/.bash_profile"<br>BASHRC="$HOME/.bashrc"<br>ZSHRC="$HOME/.zshrc"<br><br># Add alias to each profile<br>add_alias_to_profile "$BASH_PROFILE"<br>add_alias_to_profile "$BASHRC"<br>add_alias_to_profile "$ZSHRC"<br><br># Add sudoers restriction<br>add_sudoers_restriction<br><br>echo "# $(date) \| Script execution completed."<br>exit 0</details>|

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/bash<br># OpenClaw/Clawdbot/Moltbot Blocker Deployment for Intune<br># Handles: npm, Homebrew, manual installs<br><br>scriptname="OpenClawBlocker"<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/$scriptname"<br>log="$logandmetadir/$scriptname.log"<br><br>## Check if the log directory has been created<br>if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then<br>    ## Already created<br>    echo "# $(date) \| Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"<br>else<br>    ## Creating Metadirectory<br>    echo "# $(date) \| creating log directory - $logandmetadir"<br>    mkdir -p $logandmetadir<br>fi<br><br>exec &> >(tee -a "$log")<br># Kill any existing processes<br>pkill -9 -f "openclaw" 2>/dev/null<br>pkill -9 -f "clawdbot" 2>/dev/null<br>pkill -9 -f "moltbot" 2>/dev/null<br># Get current user<br>CURRENT_USER=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console)<br>USER_HOME="/Users/$CURRENT_USER"<br># Remove config directories<br>rm -rf "$USER_HOME/.openclaw" "$USER_HOME/.clawdbot" "$USER_HOME/.moltbot"<br># Uninstall npm global packages<br>sudo -u "$CURRENT_USER" npm uninstall -g openclaw clawdbot moltbot 2>/dev/null<br># Uninstall Homebrew packages<br>sudo -u "$CURRENT_USER" /opt/homebrew/bin/brew uninstall openclaw clawdbot moltbot 2>/dev/null<br>sudo -u "$CURRENT_USER" /usr/local/bin/brew uninstall openclaw clawdbot moltbot 2>/dev/null<br># Remove binaries from all paths<br>rm -f /usr/local/bin/openclaw /usr/local/bin/clawdbot /usr/local/bin/moltbot<br>rm -f /opt/homebrew/bin/openclaw /opt/homebrew/bin/clawdbot /opt/homebrew/bin/moltbot<br># Remove applications<br>rm -rf "/Applications/OpenClaw.app" "$USER_HOME/Applications/OpenClaw.app"<br># Remove user LaunchAgents<br>for PLIST in "$USER_HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/*openclaw* \<br>"$USER_HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/*clawdbot* \<br>"$USER_HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/*moltbot*; do<br>    [ -f "$PLIST" ] && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u "$CURRENT_USER") "$PLIST" 2>/dev/null && rm -f "$PLIST"<br>done<br># Create blocker script<br>mkdir -p /Library/Scripts<br>cat > /Library/Scripts/block_openclaw.sh << 'SCRIPT'<br>#!/bin/bash<br>while true; do<br>    pkill -9 -f "openclaw" 2>/dev/null<br>    pkill -9 -f "clawdbot" 2>/dev/null<br>    pkill -9 -f "moltbot" 2>/dev/null<br>    killall "OpenClaw" 2>/dev/null<br>    # Remove if reinstalled<br>    rm -f /usr/local/bin/openclaw /usr/local/bin/clawdbot /usr/local/bin/moltbot<br>    rm -f /opt/homebrew/bin/openclaw /opt/homebrew/bin/clawdbot /opt/homebrew/bin/moltbot<br>    sleep 5<br>done<br>SCRIPT<br>chmod +x /Library/Scripts/block_openclaw.sh<br># Create and load LaunchDaemon<br>cat > /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.company.block.openclaw.plist << 'PLIST'<br><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><br><!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"><br><plist version="1.0"><br><dict><br>    <key>Label</key><br>    <string>com.company.block.openclaw</string><br>    <key>ProgramArguments</key><br>    <array><br>        <string>/bin/bash</string><br>        <string>/Library/Scripts/block_openclaw.sh</string><br>    </array><br>    <key>RunAtLoad</key><br>    <true/><br>    <key>KeepAlive</key><br>    <true/><br></dict><br></plist><br>PLIST<br># Load daemon<br>launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.company.block.openclaw.plist 2>/dev/null \|\| \<br>launchctl load /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.company.block.openclaw.plist 2>/dev/null<br>echo "$(date): Deployment complete"<br>exit 0</details>|

|Script Content               |<details><summary>Click to expand...</summary>#!/bin/zsh<br><br>############################################################################################<br>## Install Company Portal and Microsoft AutoUpdate (macOS PKG)<br>## Maintainer: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br>## Summary: Download and install Company Portal PKG + MAU, with update check and logging.<br>## Exit codes: 0 success / not-needed, 1 failure.<br>############################################################################################<br><br>## Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corp. All rights reserved.<br>## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.<br>## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a<br>## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall<br>## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever<br>## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary<br>## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility<br>## of such damages.<br>## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com<br><br>## Config<br>mauurl="https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=830196"<br>weburl="https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=853070"<br>appname="Company Portal"<br>app="Company Portal.app"<br>logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installCompanyPortal"<br>processpath="/Applications/Company Portal.app/Contents/MacOS/Company Portal"<br>terminateprocess="true"<br>autoUpdate="true"<br><br># Generated variables<br>tempdir=$(mktemp -d)<br>log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"<br>metafile="$logandmetadir/$appname.meta"<br><br>## Helpers<br>cleanup() { [[ -d "$tempdir" ]] && rm -rf "$tempdir"; }<br>trap cleanup EXIT<br><br>startLog() { mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"; exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1; }<br><br>waitForDesktop () {<br>    until pgrep -f "/CoreServices/Dock.app/Contents/MacOS/Dock" >/dev/null 2>&1; do<br>        local d=$(( RANDOM % 50 + 10 ))<br>        echo "$(date) \| Dock not ready, waiting ($d)s"<br>        sleep $d<br>    done<br>    echo "$(date) \| Desktop ready"<br>}<br><br>waitForProcess () {<br>    local name="$1" terminate="$2" pid<br>    echo "$(date) \| Waiting for [$name] to close"<br>    while pgrep -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; do<br>        if [[ $terminate == "true" ]]; then<br>            pid=$(pgrep -f "$name" \| head -n1)<br>            [[ -n $pid ]] && { echo "$(date) \| Terminating pid [$pid] ($name)"; kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null \|\| true; }<br>            return<br>        fi<br>        sleep $(( RANDOM % 50 + 10 ))<br>    done<br>    echo "$(date) \| No running [$name]"<br>}<br><br><br>fetchLastModifiedDate() {<br>    lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$weburl" \| awk 'tolower($0) ~ /^last-modified:/ { $1=""; sub(/^ +/, ""); gsub(/\r$/, ""); print }' \| tail -n1)<br>    [[ $1 == update ]] && echo "$lastmodified" > "$metafile"<br>}<br><br>updateCheck() {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Checking if $appname is already installed"<br>    if [[ -d "/Applications/$app" ]]; then<br>        if [[ $autoUpdate == "true" ]]; then<br>            echo "$(date) \| $appname already installed and self-updates, exiting"<br>            exit 0<br>        fi<br>        fetchLastModifiedDate<br>        if [[ -f $metafile ]]; then<br>            local prev=$(cat "$metafile")<br>            if [[ -n $prev && $prev == $lastmodified ]]; then<br>                echo "$(date) \| No update available"<br>                exit 0<br>            fi<br>            echo "$(date) \| Update available"<br>        fi<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| $appname not installed"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>downloadPKG() {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloading $appname"<br>    waitForProcess "curl -f"<br><br>    curl -f -s --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -L -o "$tempdir/CompanyPortal.pkg" "$weburl" \<br>        \|\| { echo "$(date) \| ERROR: Download failed"; exit 1; }<br><br>    file -b "$tempdir/CompanyPortal.pkg" \| grep -qi xar \<br>        \|\| { echo "$(date) \| ERROR: Downloaded file is not a valid PKG"; exit 1; }<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Download complete"<br>}<br><br>installMAU() {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloading MAU"<br>    curl -f -s --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -L -o "$tempdir/mau.pkg" "$mauurl" \<br>        \|\| { echo "$(date) \| WARNING: MAU download failed, continuing"; return; }<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Installing MAU"<br>    if installer -pkg "$tempdir/mau.pkg" -target /; then<br>        echo "$(date) \| MAU installed"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| WARNING: MAU install failed, continuing"<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>installPKG() {<br>    waitForProcess "$processpath" "$terminateprocess"<br>    echo "$(date) \| Installing $appname"<br><br>    if installer -pkg "$tempdir/CompanyPortal.pkg" -target /; then<br>        fetchLastModifiedDate update<br>        echo "$(date) \| Install complete"<br>    else<br>        echo "$(date) \| ERROR: Install failed"; exit 1<br>    fi<br>}<br><br>###################################################################################<br>## Begin Script Body<br>###################################################################################<br><br>startLog<br>echo ""<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo "# $(date) \| Starting install of [$appname]"<br>echo "##############################################################"<br>echo ""<br><br>updateCheck<br>waitForDesktop<br>downloadPKG<br>installMAU<br>installPKG<br></details>|

### ZZZ_MAC_U_CO_SS_APP_MicrosoftCompanyPortal_PSSO
Description: Retired to support LOB app delivery during enrolment for PSSO

Can be used to install the latest version of the Company Portal on corporate owned devices going through ADE where PSSO is configured\. Does not wait for the desktop to be available before installation\.

https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/tree/master/macOS/Apps/Company%20Portal

exit 1; }<br><br>    file -b "$tempdir/CompanyPortal.pkg" \| grep -qi xar \<br>        \|\| { echo "$(date) \| ERROR: Downloaded file is not a valid PKG"; exit 1; }<br><br>    echo "$(date) \| Download complete"<br>}<br><br>installMAU() {<br>    echo "$(date) \| Downloading MAU"<br>    curl -f -s --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -L -o "$tempdir/mau.pkg" "$mauurl" \<br>        \|\| { echo "$(date) \| WARNING: MAU download failed, continuing";
